dedupe_keys.name: dundalk vestas v52 ten minute wind turbine scada 2006 2020

description: This deposit contains ten-minute SCADA records from an 850-kilowatt Vestas V52 wind turbine at Dundalk Institute of Technology, Ireland. The campus turbine operates behind the meter in a coastal peri-urban setting. Records span 30 January 2006–12 March 2020 and include weather measurements, power and turbine operating parameters. Mendeley version 2 lists an Excel workbook and a parameter-description PDF, freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. The article calls the raw format CSV, while the current repository inventory lists XLSX; this discrepancy is retained. The producer identifies a gearbox replacement from October 2018 to July 2019 with no positive electrical output. Known gaps include this extended outage; a single turbine also limits interpretation as normal wind-farm generation. A reviewer-assessed use is studying ageing, operating envelopes or local wind-energy yield in simulations. model-wtdigitwin-wind-turbine-digital-twin and data-kelmarsh-wind-farm-scada provide related modelling and comparison resources. No data or PDF was fetched.
